title: OpenClaw vs Manus AI: Which AI Agent Is Right for You in 2026?
summary: OpenClaw is open-source and highly customizable. Manus is commercial and ready-to-use. Which fits your workflow — and the managed option that combines both.
body_markdown: They run the same OpenClaw runtime, so your agent's skills and capabilities are identical. The difference is infrastructure: self-hosted OpenClaw means you manage the server, Docker, LLM API keys, and updates yourself.[Blink Claw](https://blink.new/claw) manages all of that — server uptime and updates are handled by Blink from about $45/month per agent, and model usage is billed from your workspace credits with no separate API keys. You still get full ClawHub access and can install any community skill. The self-hosted path gives you more infrastructure control; Blink Claw gives you zero ops overhead.
